title: Windmills and lighthouses are solid
summary: Recovered from USA v2.00: TOY actors with UseCollision load their collision body at placement and register dynamically; type-0 bodies now collide for ATV, motorcycle and CPU riders
details: Recovered from the USA v2.00 executable: TOY actors with UseCollision load their anim<name>.col body at the actor's placement (it does not follow the animation) and register it in the scene's dynamic list. Type-0 bodies now collide for the ATV, motorcycle and CPU riders: ENV02 windmill, ENV03 windmills, ENV04 lighthouse, ENV07 snakes, ENV08 waterwheels. Verification: native windmill contact test, browser test drives a quad into the Rockbridge windmill and it stops at the tower.
limitation: Type-1 compound bodies (cement truck, crocodile, shark, twister, NAT05 windmill, sawmill) are not yet solid.
caption: Quad stopped against the windmill tower at Rockbridge
